Class HudPanel

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.hud.HudPanel
public class HudPanel extends Object
Builds HUD panels: panels drawn on the game's heads-up display.

A HUD panel is a Panel in the HUD's host: render only (no input), placed on an InsideRegion spot of the game window or in an OutsideRegion around the vanilla hotbar, stacked with the other panels there in priority order, sized to its content. Build once from your client initializer (registration freezes at client start); MenuKit renders it every frame the HUD draws.

It holds the same PanelElements as inventory menus and standalone screens. The HUD gives them a RenderContext with mouseX = -1, meaning no input.

Usage: 

HudPanel.builder("mymod:coords", ModeScope.BOTH)
    .region(InsideRegion.TOP_LEFT)
    .padding(4)
    .style(PanelStyle.RAISED)
    .text(0, 0, () -> "X: " + (int) player.getX())
    .text(0, 12, () -> "Y: " + (int) player.getY())
    .build();

  • Field Details

    • STATUS_SCALE

      public static final float STATUS_SCALE
      The scale for a scaled hotbar slot in the status column (since 7.3.0): 6/11, so the 20 x 22 slot takes 11 x 12 and its item is about a heart's size. Use it rather than a number of your own, so every mod's icons in the column match.

      public static HudPanel.Builder builder(String name, ModeScope scope)
      Starts a HUD panel builder for one mode scope (7.4.0): the panel shows only in that mode (ModeScope.BOTH for either), read every frame, so it comes and goes with /gamemode.
      Parameters:
      name - unique id for this panel, namespaced ("mymod:coords")
